nodes.description: IERC20 token contract held by the TokenTimelock (private _token).
Address of the beneficiary allowed to extract tokens after release (private _beneficiary).
Timestamp when token release becomes enabled (private _releaseTime).
Constructor of TokenTimelock that validates releaseTime against block.timestamp and stores _token, _beneficiary, _releaseTime.
View function returning the held IERC20 token.
View function returning the beneficiary address.
View function returning the release timestamp.
Virtual function that transfers held tokens to the beneficiary once block.timestamp >= _releaseTime.
Block timestamp used for release-time gating in constructor and release().
require(releaseTime > block.timestamp) in the constructor; reverts if the release time is not in the future.
require(block.timestamp >= _releaseTime) in release(); gates token withdrawal on the current block timestamp.
_token.safeTransfer(_beneficiary, amount) external token transfer performed in release().
Constructor parameter token (IERC20) assigned to _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary (address) assigned to _beneficiary.
Constructor parameter releaseTime (uint256) checked and assigned to _releaseTime.
Local variable amount holding the token balance of the timelock before transfer.
Constructor of CATXTimeLock that forwards token, beneficiary and releaseTime to the TokenTimelock base constructor.
CATXTimeLock constructor parameter token (address) cast to IERC20 for the base constructor.
CATXTimeLock constructor parameter beneficiary (address) forwarded to the base constructor.
CATXTimeLock constructor parameter releaseTime (uint256) forwarded to the base constructor.
_token.balanceOf(address(this)) external call that determines the amount of tokens to release.
Low-level call executed via Address.functionCall inside SafeERC20._callOptionalReturn, handing control to the token contract.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token is assigned to the _token state variable.
Constructor parameter beneficiary is assigned to the _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor parameter releaseTime is assigned to the _releaseTime state variable.
releaseTime is compared against block.timestamp in the constructor require statement.
block.timestamp feeds the constructor require check, making deployment validity time dependent.
block.timestamp feeds the release() require check, making withdrawal time dependent.
_releaseTime is compared with block.timestamp inside release().
_token is the receiver of the balanceOf low-level call in release().
The balanceOf result is stored in the local variable amount.
Local amount is passed as the value argument to safeTransfer.
_token is the token contract on which safeTransfer is invoked.
_beneficiary is used as the destination of the token transfer.
The constructor executes the timestamp require check before storing state.
release() first enforces the block.timestamp >= _releaseTime check.
release() then queries the token balance of the timelock.
release() finally performs the safeTransfer to the beneficiary.
CATXTimeLock constructor invokes the TokenTimelock base constructor.
safeTransfer delegates to SafeERC20._callOptionalReturn which makes a low-level call into the token contract, allowing external code execution.
The low-level call returns control to the safeTransfer call site after the external token invocation.
_callOptionalReturn executes an external call on the _token contract, giving it control flow.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter token is only used to initialize state inside the TokenTimelock constructor.
Constructor parameter beneficiary is only used to initialize state inside the TokenTimelock constructor.
Constructor parameter releaseTime is validated and stored only within the TokenTimelock constructor.
Local variable amount is computed and consumed directly by the safeTransfer in release().
CATXTimeLock constructor parameter token is only forwarded to the base constructor.
CATXTimeLock constructor parameter beneficiary is only forwarded to the base constructor.
CATXTimeLock constructor parameter releaseTime is only forwarded to the base constructor.
